youtube.title: Do only toppers get scholarships? Myth vs Fact
youtube.description:
3 scholarship myths: only toppers get them, a scholarship means full fees, and you can look after the admit. Many scholarships use other criteria, partial ones help too, and many deadlines come early.

👉 https://app.goeduabroad.com
